text:
eva: Quick pulse — dropping the company OKR draft for Q3 here. We need leadership redlines by EOD Fri. Link: https://redwood/internal/okr/q3-draft :point_right:
okr-bot: Document uploaded by eva at 1912345678 — /docs/okr/q3-draft (permissions: product, eng, exec)
alicia: skimmed. High-level looks good but two asks from CS: add an M2 for 'SLAs for dedicated customers' and clarify data residency scope.
eva: @alicia can you paste the exact CS wording? want to keep taxonomy tight.
alicia: "SLA: 99.9% p99 latency for Dedicated tiers; on-call rota and runbook published before GA."
ben: engineering capacity wise, the SLA wording is fine but p99 99.9% across all models + burst is pricey. Suggest scope: apply to core endpoint (gpt-x-small/med) only, not experimental models.
eva: good call. I'll propose: apply SLA to GA-backed model family only.
carla: adding a leadership redline — we need a clear rollback plan for Private deployments. If a Private rollout hits perf regressions, product must be able to toggle back to previous model and revert config within 30m. This needs to be in launch criteria.
derek: from GTM: prioritize 1) Dedicated SLA, 2) Private rollback, 3) Hosted price drop experiment. If we can't do all three, deprioritize hosted price drop.
ben: Resource constraint: Dedicated SLA + rollback plan is doable but will push infra work into next sprint. Need to shift one infra roadmap item out (kvcache compaction work) to free ~2 dev-weeks.
eva: acceptable tradeoff. We should capture the rollback step sequence in the doc. I'll draft a brief runbook.
carla: also require a canary window and automated guardrails (error rate > 2% or tail latency > 2x baseline triggers auto-fallback). Add to launch criteria.
alicia: legal raised data residency redline: customers in EU must have option for region-locked model hosting or explicit DPA language. Can we scope VPC option as requirement for Enterprise-only in Q3?
ben: VPC option entails infra work but fine as Enterprise-scope. We'll mark it "Enterprise GA only" in the OKR so it's clear.
eva: action items / owners:
- @ben: estimate infra dev plan to meet SLA + rollback (due Tue EOD)
- @alicia: confirm CS wording and draft customer-facing SLA blurb (due Wed)
- @carla: provide rollback acceptance criteria and canary thresholds (due Thu)
- @derek: updated GTM milestones and go/no-go checklist (due Thu)
- @eva: integrate redlines into doc and re-share for final review Fri morning
okr-bot: Reminder: OKR review meeting scheduled Fri 09:00 PT — use this thread for last-minute notes.
carla: one more — we need measurable success metrics in the OKR. Propose: "Reduce per-token infra cost by 15% for hosted workloads" and "Onboard 3 Enterprise Dedicated customers by EOY". Thoughts?
derek: reasonable. Add a risk register line: "customer onboarding may slip if Dedicated SLA work is delayed".
alicia: +1 on metrics. Also request add a small qualitative metric: CS satisfaction > 4.2 NPS for initial pilots.
ben: noted, I'll include perf knobs we can expose to customers to hit cost target.
eva: thanks all. If no objections, I'll apply these redlines and lock the doc by Fri 17:00 PT. Reply here with :thumbsup: if you approve or flag concerns.
carla: :thumbsup:
alicia: :thumbsup:
ben: :thumbsup:
derek: :thumbsup:
eva: all noted — locking and will share updated link when done."
